en: Black‑and‑white image of a grand three‑storey hotel building with mansard roof and dormer windows. Large letters on the façade read "HÔTEL DE SAXE." In front of the hotel is a fenced terrace shaded by neatly trimmed trees, with pavilions or tents and outdoor seating. On the right stands an ornate timber‑framed pavilion with a small cupola. Several women and children in early 20th‑century clothing stroll or stand along the street in the foreground.
